## Summary

Describe the user-visible or technical change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `dotnet build Sentinel.slnx --configuration Release` passes.
- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass.
- [ ] Relevant manual behaviour was checked.

## Safety and release checks

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, production data, uploads or generated artefacts are included.
- [ ] Authorization, validation and error handling were considered where relevant.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog entries are updated where needed.
